repo_metrics.name: accessible-housing-portal
repo_metrics.description: Accessible Housing Portal is CivicTechWR's affordable housing platform, designed to centre the needs of affordable housing seekers. It provides a transparent, accessible entry point for finding listings—addressing gaps in existing platforms that often omit key information or discourage applications from the communities they should serve.
